title: Ph.D. Positions at CLS
institution: Max Planck ETH Center for Learning Systems (CLS)

about: The Max Planck ETH Center for Learning Systems, a collaboration between ETH Zurich and the Max Planck Society, offers funded PhD positions starting in 2027. Applicants submit an online form, documents and 2-3 reference letters; shortlisted candidates interview in Tübingen in March 2027.
requirements: Master's degree (Bachelor's-only applicants are not eligible)
